verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking docs have dedicated sections on 'Promoting or Hiding Results (Merchandising)' and 'Boosting / Burying sets of records', and it has a curation API page, so the pin/boost/hide half of the story is documented. The pack has no evidence of synonym definition, so only about half the story is supported. missing for 10: any evidence of synonym support, detail beyond section headings on per-query pinning/hiding, independent or hands-on corroboration of curation
